players.product: High-cap MLCCs (EMK/AMK series) for decoupling networks

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 177,624 million, up 5.8% YoY; operating profit JPY 9,024 million, up 19.1%; ordinary profit JPY 8,106 million, up 19.9%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,540 million, up 55.3%, driven by higher sales for automotive and IT infrastructure/industrial equipment. By product: capacitors (including MLCCs) JPY 126,106 million, up 11.1%, mainly automotive and IT infrastructure/industrial equipment; inductors JPY 31,492 million, up 8.7%, mainly information equipment; composite devices JPY 7,640 million, down 38.8% (FBAR/SAW communication devices and circuit modules lower); others JPY 12,384 million, down 4.2% (aluminum electrolytic capacitors lower). H1 R&D expenses JPY 7,186 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 177,624 million (+5.8%); operating profit JPY 9,024 million (+19.1%); capacitors JPY 126,106 million (+11.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: The company revised its full-year forecast for the year ending March 2026 (published May 9, 2025), based on H1 results and demand projections and citing yen depreciation and selling-price effects: net sales JPY 347,500 million (+1.8% YoY), operating profit JPY 18,000 million (+72.1%), ordinary profit JPY 15,000 million (+42.6%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 9,000 million (+286.5%); assumed average rate US$1 = 148 yen from Q3.
quarterly_data.figure: FY3/2026 forecast: net sales JPY 347,500 million (+1.8%); operating profit JPY 18,000 million (+72.1%)
